items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Wade said, I'll get old man George McCullen

ctx.x: No, he had quit playing. He was playing guitar when I left there. Oh really? Then he went back to the drum. I was so old and he couldn't make it. He just got away from it. Go ahead, Nancy. Nah, go ahead. Thanks.

So, alright. We started playing that night, playing all them numbers and you know Wade had a habit when he was talking. Y'all used to call him Busher. So, alright. He said, you know something? Man, if I had a lineup like this, go to California, Cali. Cali, we clean up. I said, let me tell you, a white band right around the corner of my house. He was begging for a band. I'm there. Oh man. I said, leave any time. Yeah? Now I'm playing at Walter's Place. Alright. Got together. Pop a mug, pop a mug, pop a mug, roll a…
news got out there, you know. And all the movies started, you know. So, we made it out of time.
